summary: Proactive Nudges engine fully tested. All 18 security tests pass (no regression). All 7 nudge tests pass when run separately. Live API testing confirms: GET /api/nudges returns org-scoped nudges, POST /api/nudges/{id}/dismiss works for owner/manager (403 for staff), POST /api/nudges/run requires master admin (403 for non-admin). Frontend NudgeBanner component renders correctly on /pulse dashboard with dismiss functionality working (optimistic UI). Event loop conflict when running all tests together is a test infrastructure issue, not a code bug.

minor.issue: Event loop conflict when running test_security_hardening.py and test_proactive_nudges.py together - Motor client binds to first event loop which gets closed by security tests
minor.workaround: Run test files separately: pytest tests/test_security_hardening.py tests/test_security_p2_surface.py && pytest tests/test_proactive_nudges.py

critical_code_review_comments: Proactive nudges scanners correctly implemented with idempotent dedupe_key upserts
Warranty scanner (30-day horizon) correctly identifies equipment with expiring warranties
PPM overdue scanner correctly identifies scheduled tasks with past dates
Supplier SLA drift scanner correctly aggregates ratings and identifies suppliers below 3.0 threshold
Auto-resolve behavior works - clears open nudges when condition no longer applies
Idempotence verified - running scanners twice does not duplicate events
NudgeBanner component correctly renders on both /pulse (LiteDashboardPage) and /dashboard (DashboardPage)
Dismiss button correctly scoped to owner/manager roles only
Optimistic UI works - banner disappears immediately on dismiss click
API endpoints properly secured: GET /api/nudges requires auth, POST /api/nudges/run requires master admin

success_rate.backend: 100% (18/18 security tests + 7/7 nudge tests when run separately)
